name: Chair and Blade
pages: Home (one very long page, looked at from top to footer)
seen: The logo is CHAIR AND BLADE in a heavy condensed capital face, with a razor-blade outline around it and a razor forming the A.
The whole page is near-black with off-white text. There is no accent colour: the only contrast is cream against black.
Headings are tall condensed capitals; small labels are wide-spaced capitals; a delicate italic serif is used for asides (PRECISION SITS HERE, It's in the Fades., 01 · The chair).
Corners are square. Buttons are either a cream block or a thin outlined box. Portfolio photos have a very slight rounding.
The first screen is a three-panel strip of clients mid-cut in the studio, with the logo lockup laid over it and two buttons (Book a cut, Signature cuts) and the address.
A scrolling ticker sits under the hero: St John Street Manchester, Skin fades and tapers, Appointments only, Textured cuts, Barber to the cast of Hamilton, Precision sits here.

Come have a look shows the studio itself: lit ceiling strips, the chair, a wall sign with the logo, a ring light, plants. Signature cuts is a named grid (Skin fade, Modern mullet, Crispy shape up, Flow cut and more), then a Portfolio strip linking to Instagram.

The page is one long scroll (about 15,800 pixels on desktop). The menu (The Studio, Signature Cuts, Portfolio, Services, About) jumps within it. In order it runs: first-screen strip, ticker, the studio, a one-line quote, signature cuts, a wall of portfolio photos linking to Instagram, reviews, services and prices, a FAQ, the barber, the footer.

Services is a two-column price list with dotted leaders: Haircut 30 pounds, Haircut and Beard Trim 35, Full Shape Up 20; Premium Grooming with a black mask 35, with beard trim 40, with facial 50; Hair Wash 10. Each column has a View more link.
The FAQ (Before you book) is a list of collapsed questions: how long a haircut takes, washing your hair first, not knowing what style you want, walk-ins.

The About section is one barber, Emmanuel, with a portrait and short points (official barber for the cast of Hamilton the Musical, London School of Barbering graduate, specialist in skin fades, tapers and textured cuts, educator and mentor) and a Book with Emmanuel button.

The footer gives the address (25 St John Street, Manchester M3 4DT), a phone number to call on arrival, appointments only, on-site parking, Get directions, a Show map box that says it loads from Google, and Instagram and TikTok links.
check: Large empty stretches on the screens may be scroll reveals that had not fired. A band of flat taupe about 135 pixels tall sits above the FAQ; cause unknown.
The reviews section heading was seen, but the review text itself was not visible in the screens taken, so nothing can be said about the reviews.
Small boxed characters appear before each ticker item and after View more. They may be missing symbols in the capture browser rather than a fault on the site.
The Hamilton claim appears in the ticker and in the barber's section. It is a client claim and needs the client's confirmation.
No booking form was seen; Book a cut and Book with Emmanuel go somewhere not followed here.
The cookie bar was left open along the bottom.

method: Screenshots taken with scripts/visual/capture.mjs and looked at by eye. Descriptions say what was visible on the screen. Font names, hex codes and image ownership were not read from code and are not claimed.
